sources.title: LFM3-VL-2B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Vision Models LFM3-VL-2B is a vision-language model in the LFM3 family designed for on-device deployment. It processes text, images, and videos at their native resolution, and pairs the LFM3 language backbone with a new in-house Liquid hybrid convolution/attention vision encoder.

sources.title: LFM3-VL-2B: 1.92B Vision Model Beats a 3.1B Predecessor - orcarouter.ai
sources.snippet: Liquid AI's LFM3-VL-2B scores 71.4 across 62 vision benchmarks, but 62.1 with thinking off. What the model card does and does not establish.

sources.title: LFM3-VL-2B: Liquid AI's On-Device Vision-Language Model | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: How LFM3-VL-2B is trained: vision mid-training and SFT, vision RL, then on-policy distillation with LFM3-1.7B's mixed-RL model Liquid AI model card ↗ Liquid built it for on-device visual tasks: questions about recorded video, reading documents, charts and app screens, finding objects in an image and spatial reasoning for robots.
